seed: Dragging on the canvas with a row picked moves that whole animation (video-animate.html, the interaction table: 'Drag on the canvas, a row picked'), at Next defaults with no switch touched. A title typed over the sample recording is given a Position row by Animate > Position at one second, then dragged at three seconds, so its path has two keys. At two seconds, between them, a click on the Position row's name picks the row, and a drag on the title moves BOTH keys by the same amount instead of keying the playhead: the path keeps its two keys, one undo puts it back. Then the row's right-click Easing offers the shared curve list a segment offers, and Ease out quint lands on the row.

steps.comment: A Position row with a key at one second, and a second key where a drag at three seconds leaves it.
Back to two seconds, between the keys, where a plain drag would write a third.
THE TEST: pick the row by its name, drag the title down: both keys move, none is added.

steps.note: at two seconds, between the path's two keys, the Position row's name clicked: the row is picked
the title dragged 90 down with the Position row picked: both keys moved by the same amount and no key was written at the playhead

steps.comment: One undo puts the whole path back.
The row's right-click Easing is the shared curve list, every segment of the row.

steps.note: Easing > Ease out quint from the Position row's right click: the row's one segment runs on it
